verdict.rationale: GitBook is a SaaS docs platform with built-in AI features (AI Assistant, GitBook Agent, AI search), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Authenticated access only restricts who can read published docs, which is an adjacent control and not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
